name: Christine Drazan

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would veto new tax and fee increases.
positions.excerpt: Veto new tax and fee increases.

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would cut taxes by increasing Oregon's standard deduction.
positions.excerpt: Cut taxes by increasing Oregon's standard deduction to better reflect today's cost-of-living pressures.

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would create correction periods for minor violations to work for business success.
positions.excerpt: Work for business success by creating correction periods for minor violations

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would support law enforcement by fully funding state police.
positions.excerpt: Support law enforcement and restore public safety by fully funding state police

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would end taxpayer funding for programs that enable addiction.
positions.excerpt: End taxpayer funding for programs that enable addiction

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would fully audit homeless services and addiction spending.
positions.excerpt: Fully audit homeless services and addiction spending to ensure accountability and deliver results.

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would prioritize affordable, reliable energy by protecting existing generation and expanding transmission capacity.
positions.excerpt: Prioritize affordable, reliable energy by protecting existing generation, expanding transmission capacity

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says she would revitalize Oregon's natural resource economy by improving forest management.
positions.excerpt: Revitalize Oregon's natural resource economy by improving forest management

positions.statement: On her campaign plan page, Drazan says Oregon should protect farmland rather than sacrifice it to data center development.
positions.excerpt: Protect Oregon's farmland because we shouldn't sacrifice valuable farmland to accommodate data center development.

positions.statement: In a May 2026 OPB profile, Drazan is quoted on immigration saying she believes the country should be a nation of laws.
positions.excerpt: I am a person that believes that we should, in fact, be a nation of laws.

positions.statement: OPB reported in May 2026 that Drazan's mailers to Republican voters emphasize gun rights with the line 'Clear aim, proven results.'
OPB reported in May 2026 that Drazan's mailers to Republican voters highlight opposition to abortion, including the line 'Christine Drazan will be our pro-life champion.'
positions.excerpt: Christine Drazan will be our pro-life champion.

positions.statement: In a November 2021 House Republican Caucus press release, then-House Republican Leader Drazan said she would oppose any bills that increase costs for Oregon families.
positions.excerpt: I will oppose any bills that increase costs for Oregon families.

positions.statement: In a September 2022 OPB candidate questionnaire on climate change, Drazan said Oregon is already among the greenest states in the country.
positions.excerpt: First, it’s important to start by acknowledging that Oregon is already among the greenest states in the country.

collection_notes: Identity: Republican nominee for Oregon governor 2026; campaign site confirmed in verified candidate file; OPB May 2026 profile is about the 2026 governor race. Immigration item is a mild quote; gun and abortion items are OPB's description of campaign mailers, not direct statements of policy. Cost-of-living and environment items are older (2021, 2022) and dated in the statements; the 2022 OPB item is from her prior governor run.
